name: tutorial-id
description: Indonesian technical tutorial: tight pacing, generous silence trimming, burned-in subtitles.

silence.comment: Cut pauses over half a second but leave a 200ms breath so cuts do not feel clipped.

fillers.comment: The protected words are discourse markers that carry meaning in Indonesian; cutting them changes the sentence. 'like' and 'you know' are excluded from the English lexicon because they are ordinary words in a bilingual tech talk.

pacing.comment: Removing more than a third of any 30s window means the detector is wrong, not the speaker.

audio.comment: YouTube's normalisation target. Per-clip gain matching stops takes from drifting.

export.comment: presetQuery is resolved against export.presets.list at run time. Never hardcode a preset name.
